# Acorn

`acorn.js` is the unmodified browser distribution of Acorn **8.17.0**. See `acorn-LICENSE` for the MIT license. Copied from the existing local npm cache; no package installation or remote runtime dependency is required.

Upstream: https://github.com/acornjs/acorn

Only the editor loads this parser. Downloaded games contain functions accepted by the AST validator and never compile source strings from project metadata.
